about.title: About Me
about.bioParagraph1: Since studying Computer Engineering at Kharazmi University, I've been drawn to backend development — where a system's real logic takes shape. My core focus is C# and ASP.NET Core, and through building StudentInsights I gained hands-on experience designing a Clean Architecture solution, implementing CQRS, and integrating a .NET backend with a React frontend and a Python analytics service.
about.bioParagraph2: Beyond backend, I'm interested in web design, UI/UX, and game development, and I'm always learning new technologies. I believe the best learning comes from building and solving real problems — not just watching tutorials.
about.educationDegree: B.Sc. in Computer Engineering — Kharazmi University
